title: RF-GCN: Receptive-Field Regularized Graph Convolutional Network (code and data splits)
description: Code, fixed data splits and experiment scripts for the paper "RF-GCN: Receptive-Field Regularized Graph Convolutional Network" (Zheng, Peng, Wang and Wen; submitted to PeerJ Computer Science). data.tar.gz contains the fixed random 80/10/10 splits used in all experiments for four public benchmark datasets: Actor (Pei et al., 2020, Geom-GCN), PubMed (Yang et al., 2016, Planetoid) and Minesweeper and Tolokers (Platonov et al., 2023, heterophilous-graphs benchmark). The scripts in experiments/ produce every result table of the paper.
